entries.name: rustext

The upstream release page describes fixes and functions for the nomemhack build; the cited release does not establish a complete server/OS/architecture matrix.

entries.name: keylistener

evidence.statement: The official open.mp installation guide lists keylistener release 1.1.2-pr as the OMP-compatible plugin release.
The upstream release notes say this release was ported to Pawn.RakNet; the note alone does not establish a mandatory runtime dependency or a full platform matrix.

entries.notes: The official guide lists this specific plugin release for OMP. The upstream note mentions a port to Pawn.RakNet, but this catalog does not infer that it is a mandatory runtime dependency without explicit documentation. Version/OS/architecture/ABI compatibility and any required includes or runtime dependencies remain unverified; test on staging.
